development.purpose: primitive and episode discovery; exploratory results cannot be reported as confirmation

calibration.purpose: belief reliability mapping and frozen decision-utility calibration

rolling_validation.purpose: walk-forward component and end-to-end validation without parameter selection

sealed_holdout.purpose: single final v2 reveal after registry, calibration and code fingerprints are frozen

ohlcv_access_note: Earlier model generations may have inspected historical periods. Only the sealed_holdout is treated as prospective-equivalent for v2, and even that is not claimed to be institutionally pristine without an external access log.

development.purpose: causal book reconstruction and execution-reality calibration

leakage_rules: No post-decision OHLCV or MBO event enters Observation_t, Belief_t, action utility, or risk approval.
A decision snapshot, protocol hash, config hash and code fingerprint must be sealed before future-path reveal.
AI review may produce only registered primitive proposals and never an action or realized-profit label.
A holdout result cannot select a threshold; any change creates a new protocol and requires later data.
Same-bar OHLCV ambiguity remains conservative unless causally aligned MBO resolves event order.
